settings.heading: One product. Done properly.
settings.lede: We specialise in stainless steel linear drainage. That is the whole business.

settings.label: What we do
settings.heading: Specialists, not a catalogue.
settings.body:
Most places that sell a linear drain sell nine hundred other things as well. The drain is a line item, the person answering the phone has never installed one, and the technical information is whatever the supplier sent through.

We sell one drain. Because of that we can publish the dimensions, draw the sections, document the outlet options and answer the question you actually have — which is usually "will this fit, and which one do I order?"

If the Heelguard drain is the wrong product for your job, we will tell you. That is easier to do when you are not trying to hit a target across a catalogue.

settings.label: Who we serve
settings.heading: Built for the people who build.

settings.need: Outlet diameters and positions confirmed before the slab goes down.
A drain that arrives right so the trades behind it aren't held up.
A known edge bar and a flush finish to set the tile against.
A body that stays where it was set and a defined junction to detail.
A fine stainless line that suits large-format floors.
Published dimensions and drawings that can go into a specification.
Outlet options that work around plumbing already in the floor.
A plain explanation of which size to order, and why.

settings.label: How we talk about the product
settings.heading: What you won't find here.
settings.body:
No flow rates, load ratings or standards-compliance claims — we publish what we specify and nothing more. No customer counts, awards or years-in-business figures. No reviews we wrote ourselves.

When we have those things and can back them up, they'll appear. Until then, the specification and the drawings are the argument.
